description: Implementation of the MtpPacket class for handling Media Transfer Protocol (MTP) packets, including memory management, data access, and transfer functions.

classes.name: MtpPacket
classes.description: A class representing an MTP packet, providing methods for packet manipulation, memory management, and data transfer.

methods.name: MtpPacket
methods.description: Constructor initializing the packet buffer with specified size.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the packet to initial state with header size.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates or reallocates buffer to accommodate specified length.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs a hex dump of the packet buffer for debugging.

methods.name: copyFrom
methods.description: Copies data from another MtpPacket instance.

methods.name: getUInt16
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit unsigned integer from buffer at given offset.

methods.name: getUInt32
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit unsigned integer from buffer at given offset.

methods.name: putUInt16
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit unsigned integer to buffer at given offset.

methods.name: putUInt32
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit unsigned integer to buffer at given offset.

methods.name: getContainerCode
methods.description: Retrieves the container code from the packet.

methods.name: setContainerCode
methods.description: Sets the container code in the packet.

methods.name: getContainerType
methods.description: Retrieves the container type from the packet.

methods.name: getTransactionID
methods.description: Retrieves the transaction ID from the packet.

methods.name: setTransactionID
methods.description: Sets the transaction ID in the packet.

methods.name: getParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value at specified index.

methods.name: setParameter
methods.description: Sets a parameter value at specified index.

methods.name: transfer
methods.description: Performs USB bulk transfer of the packet data (conditional on MTP_HOST).
